:::{#cor-marginal-slope-nonindep-interaction}

#### Marginal slope under an identity link with an interaction

Under the assumptions of @thm-marginal-mean-nonindep-interaction:

$$
\deriv{x}\Ef{Y|X=x}
= (\b_X + \b_C\gamma_x + \b_{XC}\gamma_0) + 2\b_{XC}\gamma_x x
$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-marginal-model-non-indep-interaction, worked in @sol-marginal-model-non-indep-interaction.

:::
